content: tbl:comparativeallsectors summarizes the test scores for the ablations discussed above. Our best model is the + News (BiLSTM Att) + NRA, which is trained end-to-end and uses our full architecture. The second best model, i.e. + News (BiLSTM MP) + NRA, ranks slightly lower and only differs form the best model in terms of the sentence encoder. The former sentence encoder uses an attention layer (subsec:bilstminneratt) and the the last a max-pooling layer (subsec:bilstmmaxpool), where both layers are placed on top of the LSTM hidden states of each word.
